patch_list: Plague Inc. Custom Scenario Download Fix
Fixes custom scenario downloads by setting the HTTP User-Agent the scenario server requires.
Plague Inc. Custom Scenario Upgrades
Gives 8 custom scenario save slots and unlimited downloads.
Plague Inc. Native Custom Scenario Slots
Forces the native engine to report custom scenario slot tier 3 (8 slots, unlimited downloads).
Plague Inc. Outbreak Popup Bypass
Auto-claims outbreak trial missions and suppresses outbreak purchase/onboarding popups.
Plague Inc. Premium
Unlocks all premium features and disables premium prompts.
Plague Inc. Remove Banner Ads
Removes AppLovin banner ads and the Ndemic premium promo during gameplay.
Plague Inc. Skip Rewarded Video Ads
Grants rewarded video bonuses instantly without watching ads.
Plague Inc. Sync Premium Entitlements
Registers unlocked premium content with the native engine so premium modes run without trial banners.
Plague Inc. Unlock All Genes
Unlocks all genes by earning them through the game's own unlock path when the gene menu opens.
Plague Inc. Unlock All Scenarios
Unlocks all official scenarios.
Plague Inc. Unlock Disease Types
Unlocks all disease types including Neurax Worm, Necroa Virus, Simian Flu and Shadow Plague.
Plague Inc. Unlock Expansions
Unlocks Cure Mode, Plague Pack, custom scenarios and bypasses the Play Pass check.
Plague Inc. Unlock Fast-Forward
Removes the premium lock from the in-game fast-forward button.

patch_list: Unlimited DNA Points & Fast Mutation - Plague Inc. (Experimental)
⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Hooks DNA points balance getter to provide 9999 DNA points and multiplies DNA points earned on orange and red biohazard bubble pops.
Unlock All Genetic Genes - Plague Inc. (Experimental)
⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Unlocks all 5 categories of genetic modification genes (DNA genes, Travel genes, Evolution genes, Mutation genes, Environment genes) for every plague.
Unlock All Plagues & Disease Types - Plague Inc. (Experimental)

⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Unlocks all standard disease types (Bacteria, Virus, Fungus, Parasite, Prion, Nano-Virus, Bio-Weapon) and special plagues (Neurax Worm, Necroa Virus, Simian Flu, Shadow Plague) without Brutal completion.
Unlock Scenarios & Full Expansion - Plague Inc. (Experimental)
⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Unlocks Official Scenarios, Custom Scenario Creator, Speed Runs, and Fast Forward (speed 3x) by hooking Google Play Billing and expansion license checks.
